title: The biggest dinosaurs
text: Dinosaurs lived on the Earth millions of years ago. There were small dinosaurs and there were enormous dinosaurs. Today we only find their bones.
The Argentinosaurus was a giant dinosaur from South America. It had a very long neck and a long tail. It was as long as three buses! It was a calm animal and it ate plants.
The Brachiosaurus was very tall. It had long front legs and it ate the leaves at the top of tall trees. It was like a giant giraffe.
The Tyrannosaurus rex was a big hungry hunter. It had a huge head, strong legs and very sharp teeth. But it had short arms. It ate other dinosaurs.
The Spinosaurus was a long dinosaur with a big sail on its back. It lived near rivers and it ate fish. It was even longer than the [T. rex]!
halves: The Spinosaurus had a big sail...

grammar.title: Grammar: adjectives
grammar.rule: In English, the adjective goes before the noun, and it does not change in the plural.
